registration_echo.source: docs/efv-2026-07-23/GATES.md :: 'S-XLINE-3 gate registration - 2026-07-23 (pre-registered; supersedes S-XLINE-2's V0 quantity ONLY)'

clauses.V0': xwoba_est_full (frozen completion) vs Savant FULL xwOBA on AAA 2026 both-source players (>= 25 tracked BBE feed-side / >= 100 PA Savant-side): Spearman >= 0.7 or STOP; report r, rho, bias, slope
clauses.M-A: PRIMARY: A-ball season pairs (Y in 2023-2025 -> Y+1, z within destination pool, >= 150 PA both legs, >= 25 tracked BBE in Y): blend50 of the capped gap (xwoba_est_full - line wOBA proxy, cap +-0.05) into the actual line must predict next-season wOBA better than the actual line; lo95 > 0
clauses.M-CPX: SECONDARY: same design at CPX; honest NULL closes it
clauses.AUX-1: hit p90 EV level-relative at A vs next-season wOBA z; lo95 > 0 or NULL
clauses.AUX-2: hit whiff/swing-miss (zone_metrics) at A vs next-season K% and wOBA z
clauses.AUX-3: pit fastball velo (feeds) at A vs next-season K% against
clauses.selection_bias: same-band covered vs uncovered next-season outcome gap + CI, mandatory per arm; big gap => confounded, do not ship
clauses.ship_rule: V0' + M-A pass -> feeds-based gap source in efv_statcast_line, W=0.5, caps .050/.050/.100, A/CPX 2023+, default-OFF flags, then the S-XLINE in-matrix clauses (invariance, no-harm >= -0.003, bounded pull, post-flip max served move <= 3 FV) before any flip; AUX passes inform future registrations only

frozen_completion_formula.weights_source: hem_plus.py W_UBB/W_HBP (FanGraphs family, mirrors fa_config assembly.woba_weights); identical constants to this lab's woba_proxy()
frozen_completion_formula.xw_con: feed contact_quality.xwoba_est (contact-only, xwOBAcon scale, incl. the module's profile adjustment)

event_algebra.HBP': max(0, obp*pa - H - bb) - reconstructed, absorbs the OBP denominator error (SF/SH/CI); identical to woba_proxy()
event_algebra.BIP': max(0, pa - bb - HBP' - so) - contact-ending PA incl. SF (Savant values SF batted balls) and SH (tiny overcount)
event_algebra.denominator: pa (same as woba_proxy, so the M-A gap cancels the BB/HBP/K channels by construction)

edge_handling.ibb: not in milb_history lean rows -> total BB at 0.69
edge_handling.sf: not stored -> stays inside BIP' and pa
edge_handling.exclusions: pa < 1, ab < 1, or missing avg/obp -> no estimate

v0_full.note: xwoba_est_full completes the contact-only feed estimate to full-xwOBA scale with the AAA stat line's actual BB/HBP'/SO accounting (header formula, frozen before this ran); the registered gate is the rank agreement (Spearman) vs Savant full xwOBA on the V0-2 population

diagnostics_descriptive.note: descriptive ledger diagnostics; the registered gate statistic is the >= 25 BBE Spearman above

conventions.outcome: next-season wOBA proxy (see woba_proxy docstring: pa, ab, avg, obp, slg, bb, hr; triples folded into doubles; HBP reconstructed from OBP), z within the destination (max-exposure level, season) pool, >= 150 PA both legs; 2025->2026 outcome leg is 2026 season-to-date
conventions.gap: gap_full = xwoba_est_full (FROZEN header completion of the feed contact estimate with the level row's actual BB/HBP'/SO accounting) minus the same row's woba_proxy (identical linear weights, so the BB/HBP/K channels cancel exactly); gap_line = clamp(gap_full, +-0.05); blend = line proxy + 0.5 * gap_line (z with the pool's own mean/sd, mirroring efv_statcast_line's additive hitter form)
conventions.bootstrap: percentile, 2000 reps, seed 20260723, paired for the M arms (delta rho), plain for AUX rho

AUX_1_p90ev.note: z of p90_ev within (A, season) covered pool vs next-season wOBA z; AAA early-window read was ANTI-correlated, this is the registered honest test at the younger level

AUX_2_whiff.note: whiff share = WHIFF_CODES/SWING_CODES over all pitches seen (>= 100 pitches, zone_metrics qualification); call codes need no tracking hardware so coverage is near-full; registered gate direction is vs next-season K%

AUX_3_fb_velo.note: avg FB velo (codes ['FA', 'FF', 'FT', 'SI']), >= 50 tracked FB, z within (A, season) covered pool vs next-season K%-against z (max-BF destination row, >= 150 BF both legs); pitcher rows came free from the hitter-cohort feed set (same games), so no extra fetch was needed

selection_bias_A.design: per-season quintile bands of the current-line z among the stat-line-eligible universe; covered-count-weighted mean of within-band outcome-z gaps; percentile bootstrap, 2000 reps

selection_bias_AUX2.design: per-season quintile bands of the current-line z among the stat-line-eligible universe; covered-count-weighted mean of within-band outcome-z gaps; percentile bootstrap, 2000 reps

selection_bias_AUX3.design: per-season quintile bands of the current-line z among the stat-line-eligible universe; covered-count-weighted mean of within-band outcome-z gaps; percentile bootstrap, 2000 reps

caveats: A-level batted-ball tracking is park-dependent (FSL Hawk-Eye parks dominate coverage); the selection-bias falsification is the registered guard for exactly this
CPX registered as likely underpowered; an honest NULL closes it without touching the A-ball verdict
feeds xwoba_est is contact-only and carries the module's profile adjustment; V0' validated the rank agreement of its K/BB-completed form vs Savant full xwOBA (the S-XLINE-3 amendment)
any constant xwOBAcon-scale offset in the feed estimate enters the gap only through the slowly-varying contact share; within-pool z + rank statistics absorb it (V0' bias/slope recorded)
